name: Civic & Democratic Processes
definition: Civic and democratic processes include the ways governments gather public input, ensure procedural legitimacy, and enable accountable participation in public life.

references.label: OGP National Handbook – Foundations for Open Government (2025)

challenges: Civic processes often rely on legacy or fragmented tools; trust in outcomes is undermined when input cannot be verified or when participation is not inclusive. Cross-border and multilingual participation is difficult.
opportunities: Attestations can record participation and commitments; registries can anchor policy or consultation outcomes with integrity. Privacy-preserving proofs can support credentialed participation without full identity disclosure.
